verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench offers web-based tools such as Document Driver and the Capital and Liquidation Calculators. Because it is a tools platform and not an agent, an official MCP server is a fair question to ask. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server or any agent integration, and probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec, so there is no sign of any programmatic surface for agents to connect to.
